comparison.objective: Dose 1.00 g of granules on a tared analytical balance.
comparison.physical_skill: Operate a sliding draft shield and tare button, place a boat, and finely pour loose material using display feedback.
comparison.success_condition: Correct empty-boat tare and final mass tolerance; open shield or spilled granules reduce score. No mechanism-retention criterion.
comparison.reason: Shares feedback-guided iteration only abstractly; the physical ability is precision dosing of granular material rather than mechanical adjustment and impact control.
